title: Lithuanian Parliament Corpus corpus-wide frequency aggregates

publication.scope: Corpus-wide wordform and lemma totals from the reviewed Lithuanian Parliament Corpus aggregate outputs. The scope is legislative speech only and excludes every document, speaker, author, source identifier, and temporal grouping.
publication.access: A compact manifest loads first. Static JSON chunks then expose only the selected corpus-wide frequency view.
publication.reason: This is a privacy-safe aggregate product, not an authorship, politician-ranking, quotation, or calendar-analysis feature.

provenance.citation: Kapočiūtė-Dzikienė, Jurgita, Šarkutė, Ligita, and Utka, Andrius. 2017. Lithuanian Parliament Corpus for Authorship Attribution. Vytautas Magnus University. CLARIN-LT Repository. https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.11821/17.

constraints: Describe the product as a legislative-speech corpus, not as general Lithuanian language use.

Publish only corpus-wide wordform and lemma totals; do not add raw text, excerpts, sample sentences, document records, source identifiers, speaker or author names, rankings, or author-level statistics.
Do not add calendar, day, session, or speaker-level views without a separate documented disclosure review and minimum-cell policy tracked in issue #68.
Keep wordform and lemma counts as separate source-scoped measures; do not imply that either total is the repository's general corpus word-count claim.

views.title: Lithuanian Parliament Corpus word forms
views.description: Every reviewed corpus-wide wordform total, ordered by descending source count. This measures the legislative-speech corpus only.

views.title: Lithuanian Parliament Corpus lemmas
views.description: Every reviewed corpus-wide lemma total, ordered by descending source count. This measures the legislative-speech corpus only.
